product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Industrial Round Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture - 6.5 Inch Shade, 10 - 58 Inch Cord, Chrome and Black
product.description: This sleek pendant light combines matte black hardware with a chrome-finished hood for a handsome modern industrial look. White finish on the inside of the hood enhances illumination, and the hood and base can be adjusted for sloped ceilings. 6.5" Diameter. Cord can adjust height from 10"-58". Metal hardware with black matte and chrome finish Flexible cord adjusts height for a modern or industrial kitchen or bar area. Bulbs not included Professional installation recommended. Intended for indoor use only
